title: Combinatorial Arbitrage in Prediction Markets
abstract: arXiv:2610.23517v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a framework to identify and quantify arbitrage across logically related prediction-market contracts. We prove that prices outside the convex hull of admissible payoff vectors admit arbitrage and identify optimal arbitrage portfolios through integer programming. Using venue metadata and semantic analysis of resolution criteria, we recover 1.9 million logical relations and compile them into constraint systems covering more than 255,000 contracts. We replay full-depth Polymarket order books to simulate an arbitrageur executing these portfolios against resting orders. Among settled portfolios, guaranteed profit after spreads and fees equals 2.2% of committed capital, while profit at resolution reaches 3.2%. We find that arbitrage opportunities persist longer and attract less observed participation where relation discovery and execution are more costly.

translated_title: 预测市场中的组合套利
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一个框架，用于识别和量化逻辑相关的预测市场合约之间的套利机会。我们证明，当价格落在可行收益向量的凸包之外时即存在套利，并通过整数规划识别最优套利组合。利用平台元数据和对结算标准的语义分析，我们挖掘出190万条逻辑关系，并将其编译为覆盖超过25.5万份合约的约束系统。我们回放Polymarket全深度订单簿，模拟套利者针对挂单执行这些组合。在已结算的组合中，扣除点差和费用后的保证利润为投入资金的2.2%，而结算时的利润达到3.2%。我们发现，在逻辑关系发现和执行成本较高的地方，套利机会持续更久且观察到的市场参与更少。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个结合凸包理论与整数规划的组合套利框架，通过挖掘预测市场合约间190万条逻辑关系（覆盖超过25.5万份合约）来识别最优套利组合，并在Polymarket真实订单簿回放中实现了2.2%至3.2%的利润，同时发现套利机会在发现与执行成本更高的地方持续更久。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a combinatorial arbitrage framework combining convex hull theory and integer programming to identify optimal arbitrage portfolios across logically related prediction-market contracts, recovering 1.9 million logical relations covering over 255,000 contracts and achieving 2.2%–3.2% profits in Polymarket order book replays, while showing that arbitrage opportunities persist longer where discovery and execution costs are higher.
